CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: Defines the calculation method on how the taxes are applied on the account.

Region.name: Region
Region.definition: Identifies the tax region in which the account resides.

NonResidenceCountry.name: Non Residence Country
NonResidenceCountry.definition: Specifies the country of residence, when the account owner does not reside in the account's tax region.||Usage: If present, the account owner does not reside in the account's tax region.
